t:
Securitisation is:-

I. An attempt to get over capacity constraints in the insurance market for natural catastrophes by securitising catastrophe risk portfolios and place them direct with investors in the form of securities
II. Allows issuers to convert their underlying assets into securities or Pass Through Certificates (PTCs)
III. Is a derivative that pays in relation to price movements of an underlying asset or level of an index
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: As per IRDAI reinsurance regulations, every insurer's reinsurance programme needs to be approved by IRDAI and is subject for placements with no one reinsurer rated as per regulations, receiving cessions equal to or not exceeding ____________ of all premium ceded overseas, subject to a maximum of 20%.
e: Correct answer: 10% (from the IC85 question bank).

It relates the free reserves and assets of the ins
Every risk written must be met with adequate asset
Represents the combined reinsurance capacity of th

t:
Which countries have their own domestic professional reinsurers and hence generally confine their activities to their local markets?

I. Australia
II. South Africa
III. Canada
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Infinite risk programme, premiums are held to the credit of the policyholder in _________________.
e: Correct answer: Experience account (from the IC85 question bank).

t: All the business ceded to the F.A.I.R Reinsurance Pool is retroceded back to the members with an ________________.
e: Correct answer: Almost 100 % reciprocity (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the principles of reinsurance.

I. There must be insurable interest
II. The contract is one of the utmost good faith
III. The reinsurance contract is one of indemnity
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
In reinsurance business, captive companies are often located in:-

I. Singapore
II. Hawaii
III. Dublin
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
LLOYD'S was founded on:-

I. Aviation insurance
II. Marine insurance
III. Motor insurance
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement.

I. The consideration for the reinsurance contract is the reinsurance premium paid by the reinsured to the reinsurer
II. In reinsurance contract, consideration may be a share of the original premium subject to deductions such as for commissions
III. In reinsurance contract, consideration may be agreed at the time that the contract was made
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which of the following clause specifies the basis on which the reinsurance applies, namely the deductible and limit linked to the basis of: 'Each loss each risk' - risk excess of loss or 'Each loss occurrence' - Catastrophe excess of loss?
o: Business Covered: Attachment of cessions  proporti
Net retained lines: Protecting net retention
e: Correct answer: Business Covered: Insuring clause non-proportional (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which type of Excess of loss reinsurance is intended to limit losses that arise on the reinsured's day-to-day operations?
e: Correct answer: Working Excess of loss (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the relevant factor/s from following which is relevant in reinsurance programme design, with regard to analysing exposure to various perils.

I. Geographical location of exposures
II. Risk based capital
III. Frequency and size of losses
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC85 question bank).

t: All of the following are credit rating agencies EXCEPT:-
e: Correct answer: NAIC (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Post nationalisation, GIC became the Indian Reinsurer and its main objective/s were:-

I. To maximise aggregate domestic retention
II. To use the large premium base of the domestic market to secure best terms consistent the quality of business ceded out of the country
III. To minimise the drain of foreign exchange
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Which of the following zones that are highly exposed to earthquake?

I. West Coast of U.S.A
II. West Coast of South America
III. Southern Europe
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
The premiums for which of the following business/es is/are usually shown net of acquisition costs, agency commission, brokerage and any discount allowed to the insurer?

I. Fire proportional reinsurance
II. Accident proportional reinsurance
III. Marine proportional reinsurance
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Fill in the blanks.

In ________________, keep a retention representing the combined capacity of the group and operate a group reinsurance programme.
e: Correct answer: Group reinsurance (from the IC85 question bank).

t: ABC Insurance Co. has fixed its retention limit at Rs. 20,00,000 for fire insurance. The company has received a fire insurance proposal for Rs. 15,00,000. What will be the 'surplus reinsurance' requirement?
e: Correct answer: Nil (from the IC85 question bank).

Business Covered: Insuring clause non-proportional specify:-
